title: Nimble, Crumbly Japanese Saskatoon Berries Yakitori
description: A salty, crumbly, and savory date-night dish featuring Saskatoon berries, served with a side of pickled ginger. This dish is perfect for a special occasion or a romantic dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a medium bowl, mix together the Saskatoon berries, Panko breadcrumbs, and a pinch of salt.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut oil, miso paste, soy sauce, and lime juice.
Add the ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Add the Saskatoon berry mixture to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small skewers.
Thread a piece of green onion and a sesame seed onto each skewer.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the skewers to a serving plate and garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds.
To make the pickled ginger, combine the Japanese rice vinegar and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Dip the ginger in the pickled vinegar and slice into thin rounds.
Serve the yakitori with the pickled ginger on the side.
